name: cropper
title: Image Cropper
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: Dual coordinate spaces, eight-handle drag with aspect ratio enforcement, rule-of-thirds overlay, and offscreen canvas export at full image resolution.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/cropper. Wrap your app with CropperRoot and pass src and onCrop. The default layout renders a toolbar with aspect ratio presets, a canvas with the overlay, and a live preview panel. Pass children to compose your own layout using the same useCropper hook.
